name: letters-home-mail-export
description: Help users organize Gmail messages under an export label and request a selected Google Takeout download.

interface.longDescription: Guides you through finding Gmail messages involving an address, applying an export label, and requesting a label-specific Google Takeout archive. With browser controls supplied by your host and your permission, your agent can help operate the signed-in pages; otherwise it provides manual instructions. Sign-in, security checks, export processing, and download remain controlled by Google. The skill supplies no Gmail API connection, local mail filter, or automatic upload. Sender searches include replies; choosing original messages only requires a separate filtering step. Browser content may be visible to your AI host, so review its privacy settings before granting access.
defaultPrompt: Help me label emails from one address and export them through Google Takeout.
Help me export both sides of my correspondence with one person.
Walk me through a Gmail export without accessing my browser.

publication.release_notes: Research-refined export guidance: related-result checks, verified bulk selection, explicit originals/filter handoff, and conditional Google troubleshooting evidence.
